//: Emit config. The base tsconfig is noEmit with allowImportingTsExtensions, which is right for typechecking and cannot emit; this turns both off. Source maps and declaration maps are off because they point at `../src`, which the published tarball does not ship. Source imports carry `.js` extensions on purpose — TypeScript resolves them to the `.ts` file and emits them unchanged, so the output runs in Node with no rewrite step and no bundler.
